overview_description.description:
Energy Vault SA offers an energy storage technology utilizing fundamental principles of science to deliver a storage solution that's as compassionate to the planet as it is efficient to build and operate. The Energy Vault solution utilizes the same fundamentals of physics and kinetic energy as pumped hydro but replaces the water with custom made cylindrical blocks utilizing an extremely innovative use of low-cost materials.

The system is modular and can be designed with a capacity of between 10 and 35MWh and a power output of up to 5MW. The system has been designed for a 30+ year life with no degradation in storage capacity.

about_short_description.short_description: Energy Vault offers a utility-scale, gravity-based storage solution for renewable energy.

product.name: EVx™
product.description: A gravity energy storage platform that stores electricity by lifting and lowering heavy composite blocks, providing long-duration storage for grid and renewable-energy applications.

product.name: B-Nest™
product.description: A modular battery energy storage system for utility-scale and hyperscale applications, supporting renewable-energy integration, grid balancing, and flexible capacity deployment.

product.name: B-VAULT™
product.description: A configurable battery energy storage system for short-duration applications, providing electricity storage and dispatch for renewable integration, grid services, and energy management.

product.name: VaultOS™
product.description: A cloud-based, technology-neutral energy management system that monitors, controls, and coordinates battery, gravity, and hydrogen energy storage assets.

product.name: G-VAULT™
product.description: A gravity-based energy storage system for long-duration electricity storage, using mechanical lifting and lowering of heavy materials to shift renewable energy over time.

product.name: H-VAULT™
product.description: An ultra-long-duration energy storage solution that combines batteries, hydrogen production or storage, and fuel cells to provide extended energy supply and resilience.
